dfg_h2o_l.method: N2: one grade-A value with a stated uncertainty; 1 admitted row(s), 1 independent original(s)

dfh_ca_clo4_2.method: P1: one point value without uncertainty; the width is not sourced

dfh_liclo4.method: U1: uniform over the sourced span; 2 admitted row(s), 2 independent original(s)
dfh_liclo4.notes: JANAF (TK-039, with its uncertainty) and NBS TN 270-8 (TI-042) agree within the JANAF uncertainty.

electrolyte_water_content.conditions: trace water specified for the electrolytes (mass fraction)
electrolyte_water_content.method: U1: uniform over the sourced span; 2 admitted row(s), 2 independent original(s)
electrolyte_water_content.notes: Both are upper limits (< 20 ppm, < 4 ppm), taken at the bound; TJ-049 is the dry-box atmosphere. Comparators (not admitted, E2): TJ-049.

derived.expr: max(abs(lo + 2 * li - ca - 2 * liclo4), abs(hi + 2 * li - ca - 2 * liclo4))

exchange_entropy_bound.method: D1: max(abs(lo + 2 * li - ca - 2 * liclo4), abs(hi + 2 * li - ca - 2 * liclo4)) with lo = s_ca_clo4_2_analog_low, hi = s_ca_clo4_2_analog_high, li = s_li, ca = s_ca, liclo4 = s_liclo4; range is the envelope over the input ranges
exchange_entropy_bound.notes: Bound on |Delta_S| of the exchange Ca + 2 LiClO4 -> Ca(ClO4)2 + 2 Li, the entropy that W5's all-experimental route neglects when it enters Ca(ClO4)2 through the tabulated exchange enthalpy (cp3 R2).

solvation_al_vs_li.notes: Solvated-sink input of C5 R-cell: Delta_G_solv(Al3+) - 3 Delta_G_solv(Li+) in the electrolyte. The aqueous analog solvation_al_vs_li_water_analog is flagged and runs beside the gap.
solvation_al_vs_li.range_reason: gap (cp3 R10, searched on day 3): no Al3+ transfer or solvation Gibbs energy in any registered electrolyte solvent or other aprotic solvent was found in an open source; Al3+ is absent from the IUPAC transfer selections

solvation_ca_vs_li.notes: Solvated-sink input of C5 R-cell: Delta_G_solv(Ca2+) - 2 Delta_G_solv(Li+) in the electrolyte. The aqueous analog solvation_ca_vs_li_water_analog is flagged and runs beside the gap; no R-cell pass can count while this is a gap (cp2 fix F5). Comparators (not admitted, E2): TI-078, TI-079.
solvation_ca_vs_li.range_reason: gap (cp3 R10, searched on day 3): no single-ion Gibbs energy of transfer of Ca2+ from water into any registered electrolyte solvent (PC, EC, DMC, EC:DMC, EC:EMC, ethyl isopropyl sulfone) or any other aprotic solvent was found in an open source; the IUPAC selections (Marcus 1983, TI-077 context; Gritzner 1988) give none for Ca2+. TI-078/TI-079 are Ca-BF4 cluster energies, not single-ion values
